results.title: Blade Runner
results.overview: In the smog-choked dystopian Los Angeles of 2019, blade runner Rick Deckard is called out of retirement to terminate a quartet of replicants who have escaped to Earth.

results.title: Blade Runner 2049
results.overview: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos.

results.name: Blade Runner: Black Lotus
results.overview: Los Angeles 2032. A young woman wakes up with no memories, and possessing deadly skills.
